scope_notes: Every currently displayed Readable German blockquote on these 15 pages is complete relative to its stated decoded stream and is included. No excerpt has been forced into a complete-stream mapping.
A complete stream for one printed part can end mid-sentence. These mappings do not supply the absent parts advertised in a header.

Native-frame diagnostics, alternative raw frames, the p156 A1 overstrike variant and the existing p162 D1 comparison remain separate evidence displays. They do not each have a separate readable quotation. All 15 experiment READMEs currently have no blockquoted German displays.
The two retained X labels are p124 B position 4 inside ??ERX?K??1?2??OP? and p113 D1 position 22 inside 3X13. All other omitted X occurrences in these selected streams are reviewed separators.

Literal numeral labels, every unresolved question mark, unusual spellings, repeated labels and opaque reference fields are protected by exact ordered-label equality. No question mark is treated as editorial punctuation in this manifest.
There are no display-only bracketed letter insertions in these 30 quotations. The p156 A1 [2/3] header is a separately documented transcription ambiguity, not a decoded plaintext expansion.

The checker pins the exact source stream hash and both local layer captions. It does not authenticate the historical numerical assignments, prove source authenticity, price coordinate edits, choose among source ambiguities or establish unique historical wording; those remain tasks for the individual source/cipher verifiers.
